newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS ups estimates for Ciba.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS ups estimates for Ciba.

text.p: UBS said it had raised its earnings estimates for Ciba Specialty Chemicals by an average 12 percent but recommended investors hold shares.
"The first quarter of 1997 was marked by positive currency influences and high volume growth on the one hand and by negative price developments on the other," it said in a research report.

"We have adjusted our earnings outlook to the currency developments and raised our EPS prognosis by 12 percent on average. In light of the recent price fireworks, however, shares are now fairly valued. We thus recommend holding shares."
